morceaux.1:
<head>XV. Sappho Phaoni</head>
<lg type="strophe">
<l n="1">P. OVIDI NASONIS EPISTVLAE HEROIDVM</l>
</lg>
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Ecquid, ut adspecta est studiosae littera dextrae,</l>
  <l n="2">Protinus est oculis cognita nostra tuis?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="3">an, nisi legisses auctoris nomina <persName>Sapphus</persName>,</l>
  <l n="4">hoc breve nescires unde veniret opus?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Forsitan et quare mea sint alterna requiras</l>
  <l n="6">carmina, cum lyricis sim magis apta modis:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7">flendus amor meus est; elegiae flebile carmen;</l>
  <l n="8">non facit ad lacrimas barbitos ulla meas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">Uror ut indomitis ignem exercentibus <name type="deity">Euris</name></l>
  <l n="10">fertilis accensis messibus ardet ager.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">arva <placeName>Phaon</placeName> celebrat diversa <placeName>Typhoidos Aetnae</placeName>;</l>
  <l n="12">me calor <placeName>Aetnaeo</placeName> non minor igne tenet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">nec mihi, dispositis quae iungam carmina nervis,</l>
  <l n="14">proveniunt; vacuae carmina mentis opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">nec me <persName>Pyrrhiades</persName> <persName>Methymniadesve</persName> puellae,</l>
  <l n="16">nec me <persName>Lesbiadum</persName> cetera turba iuvant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">vilis <persName>Anactorie</persName>, vilis mihi candida <persName>Cydro</persName>,</l>
  <l n="18">non oculis grata est <persName>Atthis</persName> ut ante meis</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">atque aliae centum, quas non sine crimine amavi.</l>
  <l n="20">improbe, multarum quod fuit, unus habes!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">Est in te facies, sunt apti lusibus anni,</l>
  <l n="22">o facies oculis insidiosa meis!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">sume fidem et pharetram—fies manifestus <name type="deity">Apollo</name>;</l>
  <l n="24">accedant capiti cornua—<name type="deity">Bacchus</name> eris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">et <name type="deity">Phoebus</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Daphnen</name>, et <name type="deity">Cnosida</name> <name type="deity">Bacchus</name> amavit</l>
  <l n="26">nec norat lyricos illa vel illa modos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">at mihi <name type="deity">Pegasides</name> blandissima carmina dictant;</l>
  <l n="28">iam canitur toto nomen in orbe meum;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">nec plus <persName>Alcaeus</persName>, consors patriaeque lyraeque</l>
  <l n="30">laudis habet, quamvis grandius ille sonet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">si mihi difficilis formam natura negavit,</l>
  <l n="32">ingenio formae damna repende meae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">sum brevis. at nomen, quod terras impleat omnes,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">est mihi: mensuram nominis ipsa fero.</l>
  <l n="2">candida si non sum, placuit Cepheia Perseo</l>
  <l n="3"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Andromede</name> patriae fusca colore suae.</l>
  <l n="4">et variis albae iunguntur saepe <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">columbae</name></l>
  <l n="5">et niger a viridi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">turtur</name> amatur <foreign xml:lang="la">ave</foreign>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="6">si nisi quae facie poterit te digna videri,</l>
  <l n="7">nulla futura tua est, nulla futura tua est!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="8">At mea cum legerem, sat iam formosa videbar:</l>
  <l n="9">unam iurabas usque decere loqui.</l>
  <l n="10">cantabam, memini (meminerunt omnia amantes)</l>
  <l n="11">oscula cantanti tu mihi rapta dabas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="12">hoc quoque laudabas, omni tibi parte placebam</l>
  <l n="13">sed tunc praecipue, cum fit <name type="deity">Amoris</name> opus.</l>
  <l n="14">tunc te plus solito lascivia nostra iuvabat</l>
  <l n="15">crebraque mobilitas aptaque verba ioco</l>
  <l n="16">et quod, ubi amborum fuerat confusa voluptas,</l>
  <l n="17">plurimus in lasso corpore languor erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="18">Nunc tibi Sicelides veniunt nova praeda puellae.</l>
  <l n="19">quid mihi cum Lesbo? Sicelis esse volo.</l>
  <l n="20">o vos erronem tellure remittite vestra,</l>
  <l n="21"><persName>Nisiades</persName> matres <persName>Nisiadesque</persName> nurus!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="22">nec vos decipiant blandae mendacia linguae:</l>
  <l n="23">quod vobis dicit, dixerat ante mihi.</l>
  <l n="24">tu quoque quae montes celebras, <name type="deity">Erycina</name>, Sicanos</l>
  <l n="25">(nam tua sum) vati consule, diva, tuae!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="26">an gravis inceptum peragit fortuna tenorem</l>
  <l n="27">et manet in cursu semper acerba suo?</l>
  <l n="28">sex mihi natales ierant, cum lecta parentis</l>
  <l n="29">ante diem lacrimas ossa bibere meas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="30">arsit inops frater meretricis captus <foreign xml:lang="la">amore</foreign></l>
  <l n="31">mixtaque cum turpi damna pudore tulit.</l>
  <l n="32">factus inops agili peragit freta caerula remo,</l>
  <l n="33">quasque male amisit, nunc male quaerit opes.</l>
  <l n="34">me quoque, quod monui bene multa fideliter, odit;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">hoc mihi libertas, hoc pia lingua dedit.</l>
  <l n="2">et tamquam desit, quae me sine fine fatiget,</l>
  <l n="3">  accumulat curas filia parva meas.</l>
  <l n="4">Ultima tu nostris accedis causa querelis;</l>
  <l n="5">  non agitur vento nostra carina suo.</l>
  <l n="6">ecce iacent collo sparsi sine lege capilli</l>
  <l n="7">  nec premit articulos lucida gemma meos.</l>
  <l n="8">veste tegor vili, nullum est in crinibus aurum,</l>
  <l n="9">  non <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Arabum</name> noster dona capillus habet.</l>
  <l n="10">cui colar infelix aut cui placuisse laborem?</l>
  <l n="11">  ille mei cultus unicus auctor abes.</l>
  <l n="12">molle meum levibusque cor est violabile telis</l>
  <l n="13">  et semper causa est, cur ego semper amem,</l>
  <l n="14">sive ita nascenti legem dixere <name type="deity">Sorores</name></l>
  <l n="15">  nec data sunt vitae fila severa meae,</l>
  <l n="16">sive abeunt studia in mores artisque magistra</l>
  <l n="17">  ingenium nobis molle <name type="deity">Thalia</name> facit.</l>
  <l n="18">quid mirum, si me primae lanuginis aetas</l>
  <l n="19">  abstulit atque anni quos vir amare potest?</l>
  <l n="20">hunc ne pro <persName>Cephalo</persName> raperes, <name type="deity">Aurora</name>, timebam!</l>
  <l n="21">  (et faceres sed te prima rapina tenet!)</l>
  <l n="22">hunc si conspiciat, quae conspicit omnia, <persName>Phoebe</persName>,</l>
  <l n="23">  iussus erit somnos continuare <persName>Phaon</persName>.</l>
  <l n="24">hunc <name type="deity">Venus</name> in caelum curru vexisset eburneo,</l>
  <l n="25">  sed videt et <persName>Marti</persName> posse placere suo.</l>
  <l n="26">o nec adhuc iuvenis, nec iam puer, utilis aetas,</l>
  <l n="27">  o decus atque aevi gloria magna tui,</l>
  <l n="28">huc ades inque sinus, formose, relabere nostros:</l>
  <l n="29">  non ut ames oro, me sed amare sinas!</l>
  <l n="30">Scribimus et lacrimis oculi rorantur obortis;</l>
  <l n="31">  adspice quam sit in hoc multa litura loco.</l>
  <l n="32">si tam certus eras hinc ire, modestius isses,</l>
  <l n="33">  et modo dixisses "<foreign xml:lang="la">Lesbi puella</foreign>, vale!"</l>
  <l n="34">non tecum lacrimas, non oscula nostra tulisti;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">denique non timui, quod dolitura fui.</l>
  <l n="2">nil de te mecum est, nisi tantum iniuria.</l>
  <l n="3">nec tu,</l>
  <l n="4">admoneat quod te, pignus amantis habes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">non mandata dedi. neque enim mandata dedissem</l>
  <l n="6">ulla, nisi ut nolles immemor esse mei.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7">per tibi qui numquam longe discedit Amorem</l>
  <l n="8">perque novem iuro, numina nostra, deas,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">cum mihi nescio quis "fugiunt tua gaudia" dixit</l>
  <l n="10">nec me flere diu, nec potuisse loqui;</l>
  <l n="11">et lacrimae deerant oculis et verba palato,</l>
  <l n="12">adstrictum gelido frigore pectus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">postquam se dolor invenit nec pectora plangi</l>
  <l n="14">nec puduit scissis exululare comis,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">non aliter quam si nati pia mater adempti</l>
  <l n="16">portet ad exstructos corpus inane rogos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">gaudet et e nostro crescit maerore Charaxus</l>
  <l n="18">frater et ante oculos itque reditque meos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">utque pudenda mei videatur causa doloris,</l>
  <l n="20">"quid dolet haec? certe filia vivit!" ait.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">non veniunt in idem pudor atque amor; omne videbat</l>
  <l n="22">vulgus; eram lacero pectus aperta sinu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">Tu mihi cura, Phaon; te somnia nostra reducunt—</l>
  <l n="24">somnia formoso candidiora die.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">illic te invenio, quamvis regionibus absis;</l>
  <l n="26">sed non longa satis gaudia somnus habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">saepe tuos nostra cervice onerare lacertos,</l>
  <l n="28">saepe tuae videor supposuisse meos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">oscula cognosco, quae tu committere lingua</l>
  <l n="30">aptaque consueras accipere, apta dare.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">blandior interdum verisque simillima verba</l>
  <l n="32">eloquor et vigilant sensibus ora meis;—</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">ulteriora pudet narrare, sed omnia fiunt—</l>
  <l n="34">et iuvat—et siccae non licet esse mihi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="35">At cum se Titan ostendit et omnia secum,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">tam cito me <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">somnos</name> destituisse queror;</l>
  <l n="2">antra nemusque peto, tamquam nemus antraque prosint:</l>
  <l n="3">conscia deliciis illa fuere meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="4">illuc mentis inops, ut quam furialis <name type="deity">Enyo</name></l>
  <l n="5">attigit, in collo crine iacente feror.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="6">antra vident oculi scabro pendentia tofo,</l>
  <l n="7">quae mihi <name type="placeName">Mygdonii</name> marmoris instar erant:</l>
  <l n="8">invenio silvam, quae saepe cubilia nobis</l>
  <l n="9">praebuit et multa texit opaca coma.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="10">at non invenio dominum silvaeque meumque.</l>
  <l n="11">vile solum locus est—dos erat ille loci.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="12">cognovi pressas noti mihi caespitis herbas;</l>
  <l n="13">de nostro curvum pondere gramen erat.</l>
  <l n="14">incubui tetigique locum qua parte fuisti;</l>
  <l n="15">grata prius lacrimas combibit herba meas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="16">quin etiam rami positis lugere videntur</l>
  <l n="17">frondibus et nullae dulce queruntur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aves</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="18">sola virum non ulta pie maestissima mater</l>
  <l n="19">concinit <name type="placeName">Ismarium</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Daulias</name> ales <persName>Ityn</persName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="20"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ales</name> <persName>Ityn</persName>, <persName>Sappho</persName> desertos cantat amores;</l>
  <l n="21">hactenus, ut media cetera nocte, silent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="22">Est nitidus vitroque magis perlucidus omni</l>
  <l n="23">fons sacer; hunc multi numen habere putant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="24">quem supra ramos expandit aquatica <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lotos</name>,</l>
  <l n="25">una nemus, tenero caespite terra viret.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="26">hic ego cum lassos posuissem flebilis artus,</l>
  <l n="27">constitit ante oculos <name type="deity">Naias</name> una meos;</l>
  <l n="28">constitit et dixit: "quoniam non ignibus aequis</l>
  <l n="29">ureris, <name type="placeName">Ambracia</name> est terra petenda tibi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="30"><name type="deity">Phoebus</name> ab excelso, quantum patet, adspicit aequor:</l>
  <l n="31"><name type="placeName">Actiacum</name> populi <name type="placeName">Leucadiumque</name> vocant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="32">hinc se <persName>Deucalion</persName> <persName>Pyrrhae</persName> succensus amore</l>
  <l n="33">misit, et illaeso corpore pressit aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="34">nec mora, versus amor fugit lentissima mersi</l>
</lg>
morceaux.7:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">pectora; <name type="deity">Deucalion</name> igne levatus erat.</l>
  <l n="2">hanc legem locus ille tenet. pete protinus altam</l>
  <l n="3"><placeName>Leucada</placeName> nec saxo desiluisse time!"</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="4">Ut monuit, cum voce abiit. ego frigida surgo</l>
  <l n="5">nec lacrimas oculi continuere mei.</l>
  <l n="6">ibimus, o <name type="deity">nymphe</name>, monstrataque saxa petemus;</l>
  <l n="7">sit procul insano victus amore timor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="8">quidquid erit, melius quam nunc erit. aura, subito—</l>
  <l n="9">et mea non magnum corpora pondus habent.</l>
  <l n="10">tu quoque, mollis <name type="deity">Amor</name>, pinnas suppone cadenti,</l>
  <l n="11">ne sim <placeName>Leucadiae</placeName> mortua crimen aquae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="12">inde chelyn <name type="deity">Phoebo</name>, communia munera, ponam,</l>
  <l n="13">et sub ea versus unus et alter erunt:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="14">"grata lyram posui tibi, <name type="deity">Phoebe</name>, poetria <persName>Sappho</persName>:</l>
  <l n="15">convenit illa mihi, convenit illa tibi."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="16">Cur tamen <placeName>Actiacas</placeName> miseram me mittis ad oras,</l>
  <l n="17">cum profugum possis ipse referre pedem?</l>
  <l n="18">tu mihi <placeName>Leucadia</placeName> potes esse salubrior unda;</l>
  <l n="19">et forma et meritis tu mihi <name type="deity">Phoebus</name> eris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="20">an potes, o scopulis undaque ferocior omni,</l>
  <l n="21">si moriar, titulum mortis habere meae?</l>
  <l n="22">a quanto melius tecum mea pectora iungi,</l>
  <l n="23">quam saxis poterant praecipitanda dari!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="24">haec sunt illa, <persName>Phaon</persName>, quae tu laudare solebas</l>
  <l n="25">visaque sunt totiens ingeniosa tibi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="26">nunc vellem facunda forem! dolor artibus obstat</l>
  <l n="27">ingeniumque meis substitit omne malis.</l>
  <l n="28">non mihi respondent veteres in carmina vires;</l>
  <l n="29">plectra dolore tacent muta, dolore lyra est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="30"><persName>Lesbides</persName> aequoreae, nupturaque nuptaque proles,</l>
  <l n="31"><persName>Lesbides</persName>, <name type="deity">Aeolia</name> nomina dicta lyra,</l>
  <l n="32"><persName>Lesbides</persName>, infamem quae me fecistis amatae,</l>
  <l n="33">desinite ad citharas turba venire meas!</l>
</lg>
morceaux.8:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">abstulit omne Phaon, quod vobis ante placebat,</l>
  <l n="2">me miseram! dixi quam modo paene: "meus."</l>
  <l n="3">efficite ut redeat. vates quoque vestra redibit.</l>
  <l n="4">ingenio vires ille dat, ille rapit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Ecquid ago precibus pectusve agreste movetur,</l>
  <l n="6">an riget et Zephyri verba caduca ferunt?</l>
  <l n="7">qui mea verba ferunt, vellem tua vela referrent;</l>
  <l n="8">hoc te, si saperes, lente, decebat opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">sive redis, puppique tuae votiva parantur</l>
  <l n="10">munera, quid laceras pectora nostra mora?</l>
  <l n="11">solve ratem! Venus orta mari mare praestat amanti.</l>
  <l n="12">aura dabit cursum—tu modo solve ratem!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">ipse gubernator residens in puppe Cupido;</l>
  <l n="14">ipse dabit tenera vela legetque manu.</l>
  <l n="15">sive iuvat longe fugisse Pelasgida Sappho</l>
  <l n="16">(nec tamen invenies, cur ego digna fugi)</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">hoc saltem miserae crudelis epistula dicat,</l>
  <l n="18">ut mihi Leucadiae fata petantur aquae.</l>
</lg>
